source_summary: Chinese landscape scene with layered washed mountains, a wooded hillside, small roofed structure, groves of fine-branched trees, travelers on a road, and an arched bridge. Motifs exclude seals, labels, borders, paper texture, and damage marks.

motifs.name: left_layered_mountain_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the far-left stacked mountain wall: a tall dark ochre-gray crag behind lower green slopes, with soft rounded silhouettes and faint interior contour lines.
must_preserve: faint vertical and diagonal rock contour linework
muted green and brown color layering
misty unfinished edges where peaks fade into the background

motifs.name: central_blue_green_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the central cluster of steep peaks, including the blue-green vertical peak, rounded green summit, and muted rear cliffs tucked behind it.
must_preserve: blue-green mineral wash on the central peak
soft wash texture and transparent overlaps

motifs.name: right_rolling_hill_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the long rightward chain of rolling hills and distant peaks, beginning with the broad green slope and continuing to the brown-gray mountains at the far right.
must_preserve: pale green wash on the foreground hill
soft atmospheric edges between hill layers

motifs.name: hillside_pine_stand
motifs.description: Isolate the compact stand of small pines on the left hillside, set against the pale green slope without including the larger surrounding mountains.
must_preserve: small scale relative to the slope

motifs.name: orange_hillside_roofed_structure
motifs.description: Isolate the small orange-brown roofed structure embedded in the central hillside, including its sloped roof and faint wall lines but not the adjacent mountain mass.
must_preserve: integration with the surrounding green hillside wash

motifs.name: middle_willow_poplar_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the broad middle band of tall, fine-branched trees with gnarled trunks and greenish foliage rising in front of the hillside.
must_preserve: dense interlaced twig and branch linework
pale green leaf and wash texture
small shrubs and low vegetation at the forest floor

motifs.name: roadside_traveler_procession
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left to central roadside procession of small travelers, vendors, pack baskets, animals, and a mounted rider moving along the path.
must_preserve: delicate figure outlines and facial/hat details
red and blue garment color accents
thin path lines and spacing between traveler groups

motifs.name: arched_bridge_pine_crossing
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right arched bridge area with railings, steps, nearby walking figures, and the large gnarled pines framing the crossing.
must_preserve: arched bridge curve and railing geometry
small walking figures beside the bridge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
